title: Study Evaluating Single Ascending Doses of AAB-001 Vaccine SAD Japanese Patients With Alzheimers Disease
brief_summary: Evaluate safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of single doses of the investigational AAB-001 Vaccine in Japanese patients with Alzheimer's disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of AD
* Age 50-85
* MMSE 14-26
* Other Inclusion Criteria Apply

Exclusion Criteria:

* Significant Neurological Disease
* Major Psychiatric Disorder
* Clinically Significant Systemic Illness
* Other Exclusion Criteria Apply
